citations.quote: Active: Kha'Zix slashes the target enemy, dealing physical damage, increased against Isolated targets.

core_mechanics.summary: Physical damage increases against isolated targets.

citations.quote: Active: Kha'Zix gains Unseen Threat and becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed for a brief time. Upon breaking invisibility, Void Assault can be cast a second time at no additional cost.

core_mechanics.summary: Repeatable invisibility grants movement speed and Unseen Threat.

purpose: Recognize his isolation-focused fighting pattern and AD damage focus.
title: Kha'Zix

citations.quote: Void Assault grants Unseen Threat even if Kha'Zix never becomes unseen (e.g. affected by true sight).

advanced_exceptions.summary: Void Assault grants the passive even when true sight prevents him from becoming unseen.

citations.quote: Unseen Threat: Kha'Zix's next basic attack against an enemy champion deals bonus magic damage and slows them for a short time.

core_mechanics.summary: Empowers the next champion attack with magic damage and a slow.

citations.quote: Innate: Kha'Zix gains Unseen Threat whenever the enemy loses sight of him or he activates Void Assault.

core_mechanics.summary: Losing enemy vision or activating Void Assault grants Unseen Threat.

purpose: Recognize his empowered attack after vision loss or ultimate activation.
title: Unseen Threat

citations.quote: A team's allies are champions, pets, minions and outer turrets.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Allied champions, pets, minions and outer turrets count for isolation.

citations.quote: Passive: Kha'Zix considers any enemy unit to be Isolated if they are not nearby to one of their allies.
Active: Kha'Zix slashes the target enemy, dealing physical damage, increased against Isolated targets.

core_mechanics.summary: A targeted physical strike deals increased damage to enemies without nearby allies.

citations.quote: Passive: Kha'Zix gains bonus range on his basic attacks and Taste Their Fear. Evolved Bonus: If the target is Isolated, the cooldown is reduced.

core_mechanics.summary: Evolution adds attack and Q range and reduces Q cooldown against isolated targets.

purpose: Recognize isolation damage and the evolved cooldown threat.
title: Taste Their Fear

citations.quote: Active: Kha'Zix fires a bolt of spikes in the target direction that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies. Kha'Zix heals himself if he is within the explosion.

core_mechanics.summary: Spikes explode on contact for area physical damage and heal Kha'Zix if he is in the explosion.

citations.quote: Evolved Bonus: Void Spike now fires three clusters in a cone, slowing and revealing enemy champions hit for a short time. The slow is more potent against Isolated targets.

core_mechanics.summary: Evolution adds a cone spread, champion reveal and slow, stronger against isolated targets.

purpose: Recognize the projectile explosion and evolved slow and reveal.
title: Void Spike

citations.quote: Taste Their Fear can be cast during the dash.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Taste Their Fear can be cast during Leap.

citations.quote: Active: Kha'Zix leaps to the target location, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies upon landing.

core_mechanics.summary: Leaps to a location and damages nearby enemies on landing.

citations.quote: Evolved Bonus: Leap gains increased range, and the cooldown resets upon scoring a champion takedown.

core_mechanics.summary: Evolution increases range and resets the cooldown on champion takedowns.

purpose: Recognize his engage range and potential takedown resets.
title: Leap

citations.quote: Active: Kha'Zix gains Unseen Threat and becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed for a brief time. Upon breaking invisibility, Void Assault can be cast a second time at no additional cost.

core_mechanics.summary: Grants repeatable invisibility, movement speed and Unseen Threat.

citations.quote: Passive: Each rank in Void Assault allows Kha'Zix to evolve one of his abilities, granting it additional effects.

core_mechanics.summary: Each ultimate rank permits an ability evolution.

citations.quote: Evolved Bonus: The invisibility is extended, and Void Assault can be cast up to 3 times.
Evolved Bonus: The invisibility now lasts 2 seconds, and Void Assault can be recast twice.

core_mechanics.summary: Evolution extends invisibility and adds recasts.

purpose: Recognize repeated stealth approaches and the ability evolution system.
title: Void Assault
